_doc: Inputs of make_thesis_tables.py (chapter 6). Paths only, never numbers: every number in the thesis tables is computed from these files. '$SCRATCH' is ~/hls-est-work/coord/scratch, '$RESULTS' is tools/hls-est-validate/results. 'changelog' names the CHANGELOG.md entry (or round report) that documents the run; 'notes' names the VITIS_NOTES / OPEN_ISSUES entries a rule implements. A run is a run_hlsest.py result file; it is re-scored against the current results/vitis.json, so all rows share one ground truth.

outofband_classes.ranking_run: out-of-band ranking of round 10 (OPEN_ISSUES O113); class causes condensed in 'names' from its classes.md, K1f updated for round 8's N65 implementation

K1d.name: stream-call loops left unscheduled
K1d.cause: loops that contain hls::stream reads or writes are not scheduled, so they are not pipelined (O54 (c)); the largest design also needs the trip-count-1 pipeline unroll (N40, O57, an option that is off) and the automatic complete partition of the unrolled index

K1c.name: flatten across a stream access
K1c.cause: Vitis flattens a nest across a stream read or write; proven (N55), not implemented

K14.name: name-alignment artefact
K14.cause: per-array rows that do not align by name; the design total error is small

K1e.name: RAM_1WNR copy count
K1e.cause: RAM_1WNR copy count or port demand, other cases (O11, O51; reads in if/else arms, shared ports)

K19.name: globals not access-attributed
K19.cause: a global array whose accesses were not attributed (O4, O17): priced as a one-port x36 RAM where Vitis builds a two-port x18 RAM; since round 10 the attribution is the default (N85)

K3.name: hls::vector arrays
K3.cause: hls::vector arrays in static locals (O64 (b), N44, N51)

K1b.name: greedy scheduler II
K1b.cause: the greedy modulo scheduler returns a higher II than Vitis on large or flattened bodies (O56, N39)

K8b.name: unroll of a variable-trip pipeline
K8b.cause: an unroll factor on a pipelined loop with a run-time trip count is not applied by hls-est; in Vitis the reader of a PIPO channel reads one bank twice per cycle

K1g.name: do-while flatten refusal
K1g.cause: Vitis does not flatten a nest whose loops the front end turned into do-while loops ([HLS 200-960], N64; which source shape causes it is unconfirmed); hls-est flattens

K11.name: math cores
K11.cause: BRAM of hls:: math cores (O45, O46)

K8.name: PIPO channels
K8.cause: dataflow PIPO channels (O50): one memory or one per block, narrowing or LUT RAM of a channel

K15.name: not examined
K15.cause: not explained; not examined in the ranking

K13.name: arrays Vitis keeps in registers
K13.cause: arrays Vitis keeps in registers or removes, and small arrays only Vitis has (O60)

K12.name: formula / ROM / binding residuals
K12.cause: small residuals of the BRAM formula, ROMs and binding

K1f.name: flattened pipeline II
K1f.cause: the straight-line code before a flattened inner loop is now scheduled inside the pipeline (N65, implemented in round 8), but hls-est's II for that pipeline is 17 against Vitis' 2, because 32 mutually exclusive bank stores count as 32 port uses (O87), so the copy count stays too low

K24.name: ap_uint-counted loop
K24.cause: a loop counted by an ap_uint stays a while loop in cgeist and is not pipelined (O101)

K18.name: partition not applied
K18.cause: an array_partition is not applied because the array reaches a view, cast, byte copy or select that the banking cannot rewrite (O84)

K4c.name: dropped INTERFACE pragma
K4c.cause: Vitis drops an INTERFACE pragma with an unknown option (bus_bitwidth), so there is no m_axi adapter; hls-est prices one

K22.name: multi-read ROM copies
K22.cause: a ROM read several times per cycle, ROM copies (N8)

K6.name: callee pragma lost
K6.cause: a partition pragma on a parameter of an inlined callee is lost in cgeist (O39, O17)

ablation._doc: W9r5-era pass ablation (exactclass shim): each run drops one pass from the default pipeline of the reference run.

snapshot._doc: Frozen inputs that would otherwise change between renders: the commit counts and source sizes of chapter 5 are read at these commits (git), and the ad-hoc kernel cache of chapter 3 counts only result files written up to experiments_cutoff (local time). circt_commit is the commit that records the final evaluation run in the CHANGELOG; polygeist_commit is the Polygeist commit of the cgeist binary that produced the run's MLIR (CHANGELOG 2026-10-21 'W9 round 8 review fixes' names cgeist.g = Polygeist 537d6614, md5 a5056b23; round 12's final run adds the harness flag --hls-trip-one-pipeline-unroll, CHANGELOG 2026-10-22 W9r12-impl; the run file itself records polygeist_head 'unknown'; round 13's final run uses the private cgeist of Polygeist w9r13-cgeist 34767431, md5 5b74209f, CHANGELOG 2026-10-22 W9r13-impl).
